name: Case study header (platform)
purpose: Open a platform case study: the customer mark, the H1 headline over a masked hero image and a row of four key facts (two stats, challenge tags, integrations).
description: Article header of the case-study-platform template (the page opens here; it carries the H1, so the template has no separate hero): customer logo top-left, serif 3.8rem H1 bottom-left over a radial-masked hero image (min-height 60vh), a static play-video ring icon on the right, then a 4-column row of info cards (1 column at tablet and below): two stat cards, a challenge-tag card and an integrations-chip card, the last stat card carrying a 'See how' anchor link.
